title: Rava bar Mari
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eruvin 86a; Hyman says the reading should be Rabbah bar Mari, as in Ein Yaakov.[^1]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital paragraph of Eruvin 86a explicitly has Rava bar Mari. Hyman’s statement that it should read Rabbah bar Mari, as in Ein Yaakov, remains his correction proposal; Ein Yaakov has not been freshly collated here. The Hebrew alef/heh distinction and the supplied heading are not repaired or identity-bound.
